test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain language, TRAVEL is coded as GIZEVO, POLICY is coded as KLORXB, how will FAMILY be coded in the same language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f97b5d772f8199438edf22ce97d9e87de421cd8319f173f7c41faddb06972130.png] 

**Logic:** Opposite letters are written.

TRAVEL is coded as GIZEVO →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6a32c82a02daae6e15152a3303d3831281d5c9764b0ebef80f5e9ec34777e6c.png] 

POLICY is coded as KLORXB →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fbb586e4aaa2c738bbc19cc5fd958e2f2ecefadfc1e71c790a3651288671943.png] 

Similarly, 'FAMILY' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e9e2a653b0082909cc9d063a19f7fdcfbc0ba6cfa6d17b27fe4e8422488d72d.png] 

Here, 'FAMILY' is written as **'UZNROB'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
